milestones.title: Repository audit and baseline
milestones.goal: Characterize existing code before edits. Preserve the supplied toolchain and user changes.

milestones.title: CLI foundation and diagnostics
milestones.goal: Deliver a real native CLI with safe structured output and a discovered build/test loop.

milestones.title: Canonical identities and immutable storage
milestones.goal: Implement verified blobs and trees, independent golden vectors, and atomic store transactions.

milestones.title: Native action execution
milestones.goal: Execute declared argv with real output collection, cancellation, and honest capabilities.

milestones.title: TypeScript and QuickJS-NG evaluation
milestones.goal: Evaluate locked configuration without ambient effects and with enforced resource limits.

milestones.title: Resolution, plans, and lockfiles
milestones.goal: Resolve exact dependency closures and schedule validated action graphs.

milestones.title: Profiles and transient execution
milestones.goal: Install transactionally, roll back generations, and run through jckgx without profile mutation.

milestones.title: Repository trust and local channels
milestones.goal: Implement explicit trust enrollment, signed metadata, and safe artifact retrieval.

milestones.title: Strict Linux execution and verified transport
milestones.goal: Demonstrate real isolation and authenticated artifact exchange from the Windows client.

milestones.title: Jackage self-hosting
milestones.goal: Build Jackage through its own locked environment and compare independent stage outputs.

milestones.title: Portable and OCI package backends
milestones.goal: Build package artifacts through declared actions and validate their deterministic payloads.

milestones.title: Native platform matrix and packages
milestones.goal: Run native client evidence and package smoke tests across the supported target matrix.

milestones.title: Workspace, cache, and reclaim lifecycle
milestones.goal: Eliminate unmanaged replicas and unbounded caches through measured lifecycle policies.

milestones.title: External backend contracts
milestones.goal: Deliver versioned independent plugins for execution, packaging, and repository transport.

milestones.title: GitHub channels and authorized publication
milestones.goal: Support Pages-only, Releases-only, and hybrid channels with local publication rehearsals.

milestones.title: Development and release images
milestones.goal: Build Jackage environments and release images with validated closures and real runtime tests.

milestones.title: Agent-native factory and migration
milestones.goal: Demonstrate the complete human and OMP workflow with safe source ownership.

milestones.title: Release hardening and independent evidence
milestones.goal: Replay the full support matrix, reproduction, recovery, fuzzing, and performance gates.
